moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio collapse-away, written here): Origin bottom edge: scaleY 1 → 0.05 in 560 ms back.in (site bezier .36,0,.66,−.56: it first stretches to ~1.09), opacity 1 → 0 on the same curve, gone at ~91 % of the move. Site return: scaleY 0.05 → 1 with fade-in, 450 ms power2.out. Params: duration (0.56 s) · scaleY còn lại (0.05) · origin (50 % 100 %) · ease (back.in).
